message: reads the tag at offset 502 (`<limit()) {{count(), plural, other {<span class="pct-widget__more" tabindex="0">`) on into the ICU at offset 513
$reason: `false-tag-across-a-comment` twice over, without the comment: two blocks, `count() <limit()` and `count() <cap()`, each opening on an ICU whose case draws a stop. The tag scan reads each comparison as a tag that runs on into the ICU after it. The refusal quotes the first false tag and the ICU it runs into, by their offsets: each case before this one held one ICU run into, so a refusal that quoted the last of them passed them all.
